triggers.question: Heaven's Finest says that damaging abilities grant Heaven's Finest for 12 sec, stacking 6 times, and the tooltip of the Heaven's Finest buff (805390) says that at 6 stacks it increases your Energy regeneration by 100% for 8 sec. On our test server the 6th stack removes Heaven's Finest and gives you The Finest of Heaven for 8 sec, and damaging abilities give no Heaven's Finest stack while The Finest of Heaven lasts. On live, watch your buffs while you use damaging abilities: when Heaven's Finest reaches 6 stacks, do the stacks disappear, and does a new stack come only after The Finest of Heaven ends?
